summary.en: Conan discovers some clues but he has not discover the culprit yet. Sera starts asking Ran about Shinichi's sickness and where Conan was when Shinichi was around. Conan later learns about the deceased production assistant called Nishibe, who was also Hideka's boyfriend. When all of the staff were drinking some drinks that were bought by Yota and Takagi, the assistant director suddenly falls poisoned onto the ground. When all the staff were drinking some drinks bought by Yota and Takagi, Odori suddenly falls onto the floor while checking his phone. Later, Sera almost discovers Conan's true identity after he responds normally when she called him Shinichi Kudo.
